entry.title: UMAC Brings ‘The Cabinet of Curiosities & Oddities’ to Douglas County Fairgrounds October 23-24
entry.summary: Umpqua Movement Arts Collaboration presents “The Cabinet of Curiosities & Oddities” October 23-24 at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. The Victorian-inspired show features more than 30 performers, dance, aerial acts, theatrical storytelling, and audience costume contests.

entry.title: Tillamook Air Museum to Reopen October 29 Following $1 Hangar Sale
entry.summary: The Tillamook Air Museum will reopen Oct. 29 after a roughly 10-month storm closure. Historic Hangar B was sold to the nonprofit Vintage Aviation Museum for $1, beginning a new chapter focused on reopening, roof repairs, and preservation.

entry.title: Oregon Consumer Advocates Recover $32.8 Million in Claims, Refunds, and Payments
entry.summary: Oregon’s Division of Financial Regulation has recovered more than $32.8 million for residents since January 2023, resolving disputes over insurance claims, overcharges, and other payments. Consumer advocates are available to help with insurance and financial services complaints.

entry.title: Roseburg Man Accused of Resisting Arrest, Possessing Meth After Trespass Complaint
entry.summary: Roseburg Police arrested Markus Clinton Miller, 34, on two warrants Oct. 7 after a trespass complaint near SE Pine Street. Police said he resisted arrest and had suspected methamphetamine. He was lodged at Douglas County Corrections.

entry.title: Wildlife Safari’s Boos & Brews Returns October 17
entry.summary: Wildlife Safari’s Boos & Brews returns October 17 with local craft beer, animal appearances, a haunted house, music, dancing, and a costume contest. The event runs from 7 to 10 p.m. for adults 21 and older. General admission is $25.

entry.title: Five Local Businesses to Compete for $2,500 at Roseburg Pitch Night
entry.summary: Five local businesses will compete for a $2,500 grand prize at Umpqua GrowthTalks’ Pitch Night on Oct. 22 at Backside Brewing Co. in Roseburg. Doors open at 5 p.m. Admission is free, and registration is encouraged.

entry.title: Public Forum in Roseburg to Examine Retail Drugs and Health Risks
entry.summary: A free forum Oct. 15 at the Roseburg Public Library will explore retail drugs, potential health risks, and product oversight. Hosted by the League of Women Voters of Umpqua Valley, the event runs from 6 to 7:30 p.m.
